# Master Glass Solutions — AI Agent Access & Discoverability

## About Master Glass Solutions
Master Glass Solutions provides premium commercial and residential glass installation, fabrication, repair, and 24/7 emergency support in Boerne and San Antonio, Texas.

### Key Information
- **Service Areas**: Boerne, San Antonio, Alamo Heights, Leon Valley, Helotes, Converse, Schertz, Comfort, Timberwood Park, Canyon Lake, Wimberley, Blanco, New Braunfels, Seguin, La Vernia, Stockdale, Lakehills, Castroville, Lytle, Natalia, Somerset
- **Contact**: 210-370-3700 | masterglassllc@aol.com
- **Address**: 4949 N Loop 1604 West, Suite 501, San Antonio, TX 78249
- **Experience**: 40+ years in glass fabrication, installation, and emergency response

## Service Categories

### 1. Residential Glass
Custom glass solutions for homes including shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, and bespoke glass installations for living spaces.

### 2. Commercial Glass
Glass systems for businesses including storefronts, partitions, office glazing, retail build-outs, and project-specific fabrication.

### 3. Emergency Glass Repair
24/7 emergency glass response for broken windows, doors, storefronts, and urgent safety concerns across all service areas.

### 4. Storefront Glass
Commercial glass systems designed for retail spaces, office entries, and business facades with performance and aesthetics in mind.

### 5. Custom Glass
Purpose-built glass solutions fabricated to specification for residential, commercial, and specialized applications.

### 6. Window Glass Replacement
Professional window glass replacement for existing residential openings to improve clarity, safety, and performance.

## Why Master Glass Solutions

- **20+ Years of Experience**: Commercial and residential glass expertise
- **Local Focus**: Boerne and San Antonio-based team serving the greater Hill Country region
- **24/7 Emergency Support**: Immediate response for urgent glass damage and security concerns
- **Precision Craftsmanship**: Detail-oriented installation and fabrication with careful attention to reveals, proportions, and hardware placement
- **Full-Service**: In-house design consultation, fabrication, and professional installation
